title: Ideal triangulations of pseudo-Anosov mapping tori
container-title: Topology and Geometry in Dimension Three
note: Contemp. Math. 560, Amer. Math. Soc., Providence, RI (2011), 1-17; arXiv:1008.1606v2. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1090/conm/560/11087) and arXiv e-print source (2026-11-28). Proves every punctured pseudo-Anosov mapping torus admits a canonical veering taut ideal triangulation arising from a periodic train-track splitting / Whitehead-move sequence (Theorem 3.5, Proposition 4.2).
